title: AMD Showcases 6th Gen AMD EPYC Processors to Lead Next Era of AI and Enterprise Computing
summary: AMD 宣布第六代 EPYC SP7（Zen 6 架构）服务器 CPU 全面上市，主要服务器厂商已出货，微软 Azure 与 OCI 云实例即将可用；公司称 Meta 正作为主要客户验证平台，性能对比多为 AMD 内部估算。
reason: 公司自发布产品新闻稿，披露具体SKU、价格、云客户与SPEC数据，投资相关性强；但竞品对比与吞吐数据多为AMD内部估算或预测，需第三方验证，且属常规产品迭代。；存在待复核项

News Highlights:

6th Gen AMD EPYC SP7 CPU-based platforms are now shipping from leading server OEMs and ODMs.

6th Gen EPYC CPUs are expected to power cloud instances across all major, global cloud service providers, with recent announcements from Microsoft Azure and OCI showcasing leadership agent orchestration, concurrent agent sandboxes, as well as web and enterprise applications.

Powered by the new AMD “Zen 6” architecture, 6th Gen EPYC CPUs deliver a broad portfolio of workload-optimized server CPUs spanning agentic AI, enterprise, cloud computing, HPC and general-purpose computing.

SANTA CLARA, Calif., Nov. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- AMD (NASDAQ: AMD) today announced the general availability of the 6th Gen AMD EPYC™ server SP7 processors, based on the new “Zen 6” architecture, extending its historical server CPU performance leadership as AI creates new demands across the data center. Systems powered by the new CPUs are shipping from leading server vendors, and cloud instances from Microsoft Azure and OCI will be generally available soon.

Across five generations, AMD EPYC processors have repeatedly raised the standard for server CPU performance, energy efficiency and platform choice, culminating in 5th Gen AMD EPYC™ processors becoming the fastest-ramping and highest-volume EPYC generation in AMD history. Now, 6th Gen AMD EPYC server CPUs extend AMD CPU leadership, running AI agents, accelerated infrastructure and critical enterprise applications, helping customers expand computing capacity that runs their businesses.

More: AMD Launches 6th Gen AMD EPYC Embedded Processors, Extending CPU Leadership (News) | AMD In Depth: EPYC ‘Venice’ (Press Kit, Videos, Photos)

“AI is significantly expanding the role of the CPU across every layer of the data center,” said Dan McNamara, senior vice president and general manager, Compute and Enterprise AI, AMD. “With 6th Gen AMD EPYC, customers can standardize on the proven x86 foundation while choosing a workload-optimized solution to run more agents, keep accelerated infrastructure fed, and power the business-critical applications they depend on.”

World’s Best Server CPU Portfolio for the Modern Data Center

6th Gen AMD EPYC is the world’s best server CPU portfolio,i providing a workload-optimized stack that delivers leadership performance across a diversity of applications while improving infrastructure economics and preserving the flexibility of the broad x86 ecosystem.

Agentic AI adds even more diversity to a data center as a single workflow can run agents, call models, retrieve data, execute code and interact with the databases and applications enterprises already depend on. The 6th Gen AMD EPYC portfolio is designed for that reality, matching CPU density, frequency, bandwidth and efficiency to each job while preserving one common software, security and operational foundation. That workload-optimized approach delivers advantages across critical areas including agentic AI, enterprise services and rack-scale solutions.

Power More Enterprise and Cloud Services: The 6th Gen AMD EPYC™ 9996 CPU is the world’s best general-purpose processor, delivering leadership performance, performance per CPU watt, performance per CPU dollar and performance per socket. An AMD EPYC 9996 CPU-based system delivers up to 3.7x more performance compared with an Nvidia Vera CPU-based system and up to 2.2x the performance and 2.0x the performance per dollar of an Intel® Xeon® 6980P system.ii For customers, that can translate into more applications, transactions and users supported by each server, helping create capacity for new workloads within existing data center power and footprint limitations.

Lead Across Every Tier of Agentic AI: Agentic AI infrastructure spans three distinct CPU roles – general-purpose services, GPU host nodes, and agent sandboxes – and 6th Gen AMD EPYC provides a workload-optimized processor for each. High-frequency host-node processors, with up to 5.3 GHz, can deliver up to 1.8x the LLM output throughput of previous generation EPYC processorsiii and high-density AMD EPYC processors can provide up to ~3.3x agents-per-CPU-watt advantage over Nvidia Vera and ~2.5x over Intel Xeon 6980P for hosting agent sandboxes.iv Additionally, for agent sandboxes, AMD EPYC 9996 CPU-based servers can support an estimated ~1.18x as many agents per rack within the same 35 kilowatt power envelope as systems using default power-management settings.v

The competitive choice is increasingly straightforward. With 6th Gen AMD EPYC, customers do not have to settle for a one-size-fits-all CPU in a data center that is anything but uniform. AMD EPYC delivers the performance, choice and ecosystem support needed to move AI from answers to action and prepare for what comes next.

From the Server to Rack-Scale AI

6th Gen AMD EPYC extends its leadership from individual servers to AMD Helion™ agentic AI racks, giving customers three deployment options matched to how and where they operate: AMD Helion Liquid, designed to sit side-by-side with AMD Helios™ rackscale solution in large-scale agentic AI deployments, for maximum agent density; AMD Helion Air for expanding agent capacity within existing air-cooled data centers; and AMD Helion Air Inference for combining CPU execution and local GPU inference in one rack. AMD has worked across the server ecosystem to help develop the high-density AMD Helion rack with some configurations reaching up to 73,728 threads in one rack, delivering the most agents available in a rack. Customers can choose the balance of CPU and GPU capacity, cooling and connectivity that fits their infrastructure as agent demand grows.

Broad Ecosystem Support and Availability

Systems powered by 6th Gen AMD EPYC server processors are shipping from leading server vendors:

Meta is working with AMD as a lead customer and has been validating 6th Gen AMD EPYC CPU-based platforms as the companies prepare for deployment at scale.

Microsoft Azure is bringing 6th Gen AMD EPYC to customers across the AI infrastructure stack, with Azure HDv2 now in preview for AI data processing, agentic AI and HPC; Azure HXv2 for EDA and technical computing; and Azure ND MI455X v7, based on AMD Helios, for production-scale AI inference.

AMD recently shared updates to its multigeneration collaboration with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). OCI Compute E7 cloud compute instances will be powered by 6th Gen AMD EPYC server processors, supporting enterprise applications and the CPU services surrounding AI models.

With 6th Gen AMD EPYC, AMD is extending five generations of server CPU leadership into the agentic AI era; delivering more compute, better economics and more choice from the server to the rack. Across enterprise, cloud, HPC and AI infrastructure, EPYC provides a broad portfolio built for the workloads customers run today and what comes next.

iii 9xx6-022: Model-weight CPU-offload LLM inference output throughput comparison based on AMD internal testing measured on a PCIe Gen 5 x16 host link and estimated projected to PCIe Gen 6 x16 by host-to-GPU link bandwidth, as of 7/13/2026. Comparison is a 6th Gen AMD EPYC 96c HF processor host node (PCIe Gen 6, 5GHz) versus a 5th Gen AMD EPYC 9575F (PCIe Gen 5, 5GHz), with a 6th Gen Intel Xeon 6960P host node as a competitive reference. All measured systems were run 2-socket (full node) with SMT disabled. Workload: Qwen3-30B-A3B, BF16 weights (approximately 61 GB resident), tensor-parallel=1, 1024 input tokens, 256 output tokens, vLLM CPU-offload, median of n=3 iterations, measured on 1x NVIDIA B200. Measured Gen 5 output throughput for the 5th Gen AMD EPYC 9575F was 148.4, 114.8, 93.8, and 61.7 tokens per second at 6, 9, 12, and 20 GB of offloaded weights, with PCIe receive bandwidth pinned at 89 to 95 percent of the Gen 5 x16 ceiling and host DRAM read bandwidth below 10 percent of its 614 GB/s ceiling, establishing the PCIe link (not host memory) as the throughput limiter. Because decode is PCIe-transfer-bound, doubling host-to-GPU bandwidth (Gen 5 x16 at 64 GB/s per direction to Gen 6 x16 at 128 GB/s per direction) projects a 1.8x to 1.9x throughput ceiling for the 6th Gen AMD EPYC 96c HF processor. Measured Gen 5 output throughput for the 6th Gen Intel Xeon 6960P was 104.9 and 82.3 tokens per second at 9 and 12 GB of offloaded weights (median of n=3 iterations, same NVIDIA B200 host and vLLM configuration), versus 114.8 and 93.8 tokens per second for the 5th Gen AMD EPYC 9575F at the same offload points, so the 5th Gen AMD EPYC 9575F delivers 1.09x and 1.14x the 6th Gen Intel Xeon 6960P output throughput (up to 1.1x). Memory configuration was 24x 128 GB DDR5-6400 (AMD) and 24x 64 GB DDR5-6400 (Intel); host DRAM utilization remained below 10 percent throughout, so memory capacity was not the throughput limiter. Preliminary performance estimates based on AMD engineering projections or measurements as of 7/13/2026 and subject to change. PCIe is a registered trademark of PCI-SIG Corporation.

v 9xx6-086A: Agents per rack comparison based on AMD analysis as of November 2026 of AMD EPYC™ 9996 (256 cores, SMT on, 600W Default CPU Power) servers with 16 DDR5-8000 RDIMMs per socket in a 35 kW rack (maximum 20 servers per rack).
Default provisioning (830W combined SOC and DIMM power per socket): 16 servers per rack, 1.00x agents per rack.
UPP with a 10% lower combined SOC and DIMM power limit (747W per socket): 17.8 servers per rack, 1.11x agents per rack.
UPP with a 15% lower combined SOC and DIMM power limit (706W per socket): 18.8 servers per rack, 1.18x agents per rack.
Agents per watt with UPP: AMD EPYC 9996 (256 cores, SMT on, 600W Default CPU Power) is estimated to provide ~1.9x the agents per CPU W of Arm AGI (136 cores, 1 thread per core, 300W TDP). With UPP at a 15% lower combined SOC and DIMM power limit, the estimated agents per rack watt increase by 1.18x, for an estimated ~2.2x agents per watt advantage. Arm AGI specifications from https://www.arm.com/products/cloud-datacenter/arm-agi-cpu#Specifications.
Servers per rack are estimated by scaling the number of servers that fit in the rack power envelope inversely with the per-server power limit, without rounding to whole servers.
Estimated average per-server performance reduction of 0% at the 10% lower limit and 1% at the 15% lower limit, based on AMD internal testing of a 5th Gen AMD EPYC™ 128-core 500W processor running SPEC CPU®2017 integer workloads.
Agent counts are estimates derived from available CPU thread resources used as a proxy under a consistent theoretical workload. Actual agent capacity and throughput will vary based on workload, model, memory, software, orchestration, and system configuration.
UPP power savings and performance impact depend on measured DIMM power and will vary with workload and operating conditions. System manufacturers may vary configurations, yielding different results.

blocks.text: 加利福尼亚州圣克拉拉，Nov. 10, 2026（GLOBE NEWSWIRE）-- AMD（NASDAQ: AMD）今日宣布，基于全新 “Zen 6” 架构的第六代 AMD EPYC™ 服务器 SP7 处理器全面上市，在 AI 为整个数据中心带来新需求之际，延续其服务器 CPU 性能的长期领先地位。搭载新 CPU 的系统正由领先服务器厂商出货，来自 Microsoft Azure 和 OCI 的云实例也将很快全面可用。
历经五代产品，AMD EPYC 处理器不断抬升服务器 CPU 性能、能效和平台选择的标准，最终使第五代 AMD EPYC™ 处理器成为 AMD 历史上爬坡最快、出货量最高的 EPYC 代际。如今，第六代 AMD EPYC 服务器 CPU 延续 AMD CPU 的领导地位，可运行 AI 智能体、加速基础设施和关键企业应用，帮助客户扩展支撑其业务的计算容量。
更多：AMD 推出第六代 AMD EPYC 嵌入式处理器，延续 CPU 领导地位（新闻）| AMD 深度解读：EPYC ‘Venice’（新闻资料包、视频、照片）
“AI 正在显著扩展 CPU 在数据中心每一层的作用，”AMD 计算与企业 AI 高级副总裁兼总经理 Dan McNamara 表示。“借助第六代 AMD EPYC，客户可以标准化于经过验证的 x86 基础，同时选择工作负载优化解决方案来运行更多智能体、为加速基础设施持续提供数据，并为他们依赖的关键业务应用提供动力。”
面向现代数据中心的全球最佳服务器 CPU 产品组合
第六代 AMD EPYC 是全球最佳服务器 CPU 产品组合i，提供工作负载优化产品栈，在多样化应用中实现领先性能，同时改善基础设施经济性并保留广泛 x86 生态系统的灵活性。
智能体 AI 为数据中心带来更多多样性，因为单一工作流即可运行智能体、调用模型、检索数据、执行代码，并与企业已经依赖的数据库和应用交互。第六代 AMD EPYC 产品组合正是为这一现实而设计，使 CPU 密度、频率、带宽和效率匹配每项工作负载，同时保留统一的软件、安全和运营基础。这种工作负载优化方法在智能体 AI、企业服务和机架级解决方案等关键领域带来优势。

items: 为更多企业和云服务提供动力：第六代 AMD EPYC™ 9996 CPU 是全球最佳通用处理器，在性能、每 CPU 瓦特性能、每 CPU 美元性能和每插槽性能方面均处于领先地位。与基于 Nvidia Vera CPU 的系统相比，基于 AMD EPYC 9996 CPU 的系统最高可提供 3.7 倍性能；与 Intel® Xeon® 6980P 系统相比，性能最高可达 2.2 倍，每美元性能最高可达 2.0 倍。ii 对客户而言，这意味着每台服务器可支持更多应用、交易和用户，有助于在现有数据中心功耗和空间限制内为新工作负载创造容量。

在智能体 AI 的每一层级均领先：智能体 AI 基础设施涵盖三种不同的 CPU 角色——通用服务、GPU 主机节点和智能体沙箱——6th Gen AMD EPYC 为每种角色提供工作负载优化处理器。高频主机节点处理器最高可达 5.3 GHz，可提供最高达上一代 EPYC 处理器iii 1.8 倍的 LLM 输出吞吐量；高密度 AMD EPYC 处理器在托管智能体沙箱时，相较 Nvidia Vera 可提供最高约 3.3 倍的每 CPU 瓦特智能体数量优势，相较 Intel Xeon 6980P 可提供最高约 2.5 倍优势。iv 此外，对于智能体沙箱，基于 AMD EPYC 9996 CPU 的服务器在相同的 35 千瓦功耗包络内，与使用默认电源管理设置的系统相比，估计每机架可支持约 1.18 倍的智能体数量。v

从服务器到机架级 AI

6th Gen AMD EPYC 将其领导地位从单个服务器延伸至 AMD Helion™ 智能体 AI 机架，为客户提供三种与其运营方式和地点相匹配的部署选项：AMD Helion Liquid 专为在大规模智能体 AI 部署中与 AMD Helios™ 机架级解决方案并排部署而设计，以实现最大智能体密度；AMD Helion Air 用于在现有风冷数据中心内扩展智能体容量；AMD Helion Air Inference 用于在一个机架内结合 CPU 执行与本地 GPU 推理。AMD 与服务器生态系统各方合作，帮助开发高密度 AMD Helion 机架，部分配置在一个机架内最高可达 73,728 个线程，提供单机架内可用的最多智能体数量。随着智能体需求增长，客户可以选择适合其基础设施的 CPU 与 GPU 容量、冷却和连接性平衡。

新闻要点：

基于第六代 AMD EPYC SP7 CPU 的平台现已从领先的服务器 OEM 和 ODM 出货。

第六代 EPYC CPU 预计将为全球所有主要云服务提供商的云实例提供动力，Microsoft Azure 和 OCI 最近的公告展示了领先的智能体编排、并发智能体沙箱以及 Web 和企业应用。

第六代 EPYC CPU 采用全新 AMD “Zen 6” 架构，提供广泛的工作负载优化服务器 CPU 产品组合，覆盖智能体 AI、企业、云计算、HPC 和通用计算。

加利福尼亚州圣克拉拉，Nov. 10, 2026（GLOBE NEWSWIRE）-- AMD（NASDAQ: AMD）今日宣布，基于全新 “Zen 6” 架构的第六代 AMD EPYC™ 服务器 SP7 处理器全面上市，在 AI 为整个数据中心带来新需求之际，延续其服务器 CPU 性能的长期领先地位。搭载新 CPU 的系统正由领先服务器厂商出货，来自 Microsoft Azure 和 OCI 的云实例也将很快全面可用。

历经五代产品，AMD EPYC 处理器不断抬升服务器 CPU 性能、能效和平台选择的标准，最终使第五代 AMD EPYC™ 处理器成为 AMD 历史上爬坡最快、出货量最高的 EPYC 代际。如今，第六代 AMD EPYC 服务器 CPU 延续 AMD CPU 的领导地位，可运行 AI 智能体、加速基础设施和关键企业应用，帮助客户扩展支撑其业务的计算容量。

更多：AMD 推出第六代 AMD EPYC 嵌入式处理器，延续 CPU 领导地位（新闻）| AMD 深度解读：EPYC ‘Venice’（新闻资料包、视频、照片）

“AI 正在显著扩展 CPU 在数据中心每一层的作用，”AMD 计算与企业 AI 高级副总裁兼总经理 Dan McNamara 表示。“借助第六代 AMD EPYC，客户可以标准化于经过验证的 x86 基础，同时选择工作负载优化解决方案来运行更多智能体、为加速基础设施持续提供数据，并为他们依赖的关键业务应用提供动力。”

面向现代数据中心的全球最佳服务器 CPU 产品组合

第六代 AMD EPYC 是全球最佳服务器 CPU 产品组合i，提供工作负载优化产品栈，在多样化应用中实现领先性能，同时改善基础设施经济性并保留广泛 x86 生态系统的灵活性。

智能体 AI 为数据中心带来更多多样性，因为单一工作流即可运行智能体、调用模型、检索数据、执行代码，并与企业已经依赖的数据库和应用交互。第六代 AMD EPYC 产品组合正是为这一现实而设计，使 CPU 密度、频率、带宽和效率匹配每项工作负载，同时保留统一的软件、安全和运营基础。这种工作负载优化方法在智能体 AI、企业服务和机架级解决方案等关键领域带来优势。

为更多企业和云服务提供动力：第六代 AMD EPYC™ 9996 CPU 是全球最佳通用处理器，在性能、每 CPU 瓦特性能、每 CPU 美元性能和每插槽性能方面均处于领先地位。与基于 Nvidia Vera CPU 的系统相比，基于 AMD EPYC 9996 CPU 的系统最高可提供 3.7 倍性能；与 Intel® Xeon® 6980P 系统相比，性能最高可达 2.2 倍，每美元性能最高可达 2.0 倍。ii 对客户而言，这意味着每台服务器可支持更多应用、交易和用户，有助于在现有数据中心功耗和空间限制内为新工作负载创造容量。

在智能体 AI 的每一层级均领先：智能体 AI 基础设施涵盖三种不同的 CPU 角色——通用服务、GPU 主机节点和智能体沙箱——6th Gen AMD EPYC 为每种角色提供工作负载优化处理器。高频主机节点处理器最高可达 5.3 GHz，可提供最高达上一代 EPYC 处理器iii 1.8 倍的 LLM 输出吞吐量；高密度 AMD EPYC 处理器在托管智能体沙箱时，相较 Nvidia Vera 可提供最高约 3.3 倍的每 CPU 瓦特智能体数量优势，相较 Intel Xeon 6980P 可提供最高约 2.5 倍优势。iv 此外，对于智能体沙箱，基于 AMD EPYC 9996 CPU 的服务器在相同的 35 千瓦功耗包络内，与使用默认电源管理设置的系统相比，估计每机架可支持约 1.18 倍的智能体数量。v

竞争性选择正变得越来越明确。借助 6th Gen AMD EPYC，客户不必在绝非统一的数据中心里勉强接受一款“一刀切”的 CPU。AMD EPYC 提供所需的性能、选择和生态系统支持，以推动 AI 从给出答案迈向采取行动，并为下一步做好准备。

从服务器到机架级 AI

6th Gen AMD EPYC 将其领导地位从单个服务器延伸至 AMD Helion™ 智能体 AI 机架，为客户提供三种与其运营方式和地点相匹配的部署选项：AMD Helion Liquid 专为在大规模智能体 AI 部署中与 AMD Helios™ 机架级解决方案并排部署而设计，以实现最大智能体密度；AMD Helion Air 用于在现有风冷数据中心内扩展智能体容量；AMD Helion Air Inference 用于在一个机架内结合 CPU 执行与本地 GPU 推理。AMD 与服务器生态系统各方合作，帮助开发高密度 AMD Helion 机架，部分配置在一个机架内最高可达 73,728 个线程，提供单机架内可用的最多智能体数量。随着智能体需求增长，客户可以选择适合其基础设施的 CPU 与 GPU 容量、冷却和连接性平衡。

广泛的生态系统支持与可用性

搭载 6th Gen AMD EPYC 服务器处理器的系统正从领先服务器供应商出货：

Meta 正作为主要客户与 AMD 合作，并一直在验证基于 6th Gen AMD EPYC CPU 的平台，双方正在为大规模部署做准备。

Microsoft Azure 正将 6th Gen AMD EPYC 带给 AI 基础设施堆栈各层的客户：Azure HDv2 现已进入预览，用于 AI 数据处理、智能体 AI 和 HPC；Azure HXv2 用于 EDA 和技术计算；基于 AMD Helios 的 Azure ND MI455X v7 用于生产规模 AI 推理。

AMD 最近分享了其与 Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) 多代合作的最新进展。OCI Compute E7 云实例将由 6th Gen AMD EPYC 服务器处理器提供支持，支持企业应用以及围绕 AI 模型的 CPU 服务。

借助 6th Gen AMD EPYC，AMD 正将五代服务器 CPU 领导地位延伸至智能体 AI 时代；从服务器到机架，带来更多算力、更佳经济性和更多选择。在企业、云、HPC 和 AI 基础设施领域，EPYC 提供广泛的产品组合，专为客户当前运行的工作负载以及未来工作负载而打造。
